items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Giddis had an undertaking parlor... Ginny Giddis was her name. They called them Giddis and Morse. They were partners.

ctx.x: Oh, that was one of the big things. And they had a cemetery not far from my house, you see. Now, Giddis... Giddis had an undertaking parlor; that same Giddis and Morse in New Orleans that had that undertaking parlor with that big eye in front of it at one time, that would look at you...
Gertrude Giddis or someone like that...
